title: Activation-rescale orchestration and hybrid INT8/FP8 validation pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement an activation-rescale orchestration layer plus a hybrid INT8/FP8 validation pipeline. The goal is to reduce headroom lost to activation skew across transformer layers by inserting lightweight rescale ops during calibration and fold these rescale factors into runtime kernels. Provide a comprehensive calibration harness that runs per-layer and per-channel scale search, supports hybrid FP8 fallback for numerically sensitive layers, and produces accuracy vs latency/cost profiles for automated rollout decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness produces per-layer scale candidates and a ranked list of FP8-fallback candidates for three representative models (Llama-2-7B, Mixtral-8x7B, and a 70B family model)
Runtime kernel supports folded rescale factors without adding extra ops to the inference graph and matches the harness quantization decisions at 0.5% test-set perplexity regression threshold
End-to-end eval dashboard shows latency, P99, and token cost delta for INT8 with rescale vs baseline FP16 and FP8 fallback configurations
Automated rollout plan (canary -> regional -> global) defined with rollback conditions and telemetry hooks for quality regressions
tasks: Design rescale op semantics and provenance (how factors are named, stored, and versioned)
Extend calibration harness to search per-channel and per-layer rescale multipliers and record candidate sets
Implement folding logic in runtime kernel selection so kernels can accept precomputed rescale factors (no extra graph hop)
Add hybrid FP8 fallback path that marks layers as FP8 if INT8 with rescale exceeds accuracy threshold
Build eval suite to compute perplexity/regression on standard eval sets and track latency/token-cost metrics
Integrate results into console rollout UI and add alerting for quality regressions
